verdict.rationale: Ghostty ships a developer library (libghostty/libghostty-vt), so an API reference is a fair question for this product. The evidence only shows a static config reference and a reference on control sequences. Nothing shows an interactive API explorer or runnable examples, and probes for OpenAPI/Swagger specs all returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
